description: This file manages timers related to voice call durations and transcript waiting, including starting/stopping max duration timers and handling transcript waiters.

methods.name: clearMaxDurationTimer
methods.description: Clears the maximum duration timer for a specific call.

methods.name: startMaxDurationTimer
methods.description: Starts a timer for maximum call duration, ending the call if the timer expires.

methods.name: clearTranscriptWaiter
methods.description: Clears a transcript waiter for a specific call.

methods.name: rejectTranscriptWaiter
methods.description: Rejects a transcript waiter with a specified reason.

methods.name: resolveTranscriptWaiter
methods.description: Resolves a transcript waiter with the received transcript.

methods.name: waitForFinalTranscript
methods.description: Returns a promise that resolves when the final transcript is received or rejects on timeout.
